src: 3x3 sprite corner s with a singleton marker diagonally outside it
dst: sprite corner d touched by the missing corner of the three-marker square
match_cond: the singleton-marked corner s maps to the missing-corner target d

symbol_instructions: marker pixels encode source and target sprite corners
